name: A Short Hike
short_description: Hike, climb and glide around a small island park to reach the peak and get a phone signal.
sources: oracle study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no store fetch, no game files)
summary: Hike, climb and glide around a small island park to reach the peak and get a phone signal.

identity.core_loop: Wander, chat, find golden feathers, climb a cliff until your stamina runs out, glide down, find another way up.
identity.ui_and_game_feel: Light and free; climbing feels like a small brave push, gliding like a reward.

hud_coverage.method: Oracle study from public knowledge of the game, in our own words; not yet measured on capture

information_grammar.note: Golden feathers in a small row show how much climb you have; the park's signs, hikers and paths point the way. A paper map is summoned.

identity.art_direction: Chunky low-poly world drawn at low resolution with crisp pixels, soft flat colour.

rendering.signature: Simple low-poly 3D rendered at a low resolution and scaled up with crisp pixels, so soft colours and shapes read like pixel art.
rendering.source: oracle rendering study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no captures, no game files)
rendering.lesson: Rendering small and scaling up crisp is a one-line look that makes simple models charming.

tricks: A few simple keyed cycles on a chunky low-poly bird, carried by the low-resolution pixel look
Climbing and gliding are separate simple states with quick, forgiving transitions
motion.lesson: A tiny animation set is enough when the style is chunky and the transitions are quick.
motion.source: oracle motion study 2026-10-23 (public talks, interviews and breakdowns; no game files)

identity.audio_mood: Bright adaptive music that shifts by area; birds and wind.
identity.lessons_for_abbies_world: Climbing with a visible stamina you grow by exploring; a small island that is fully readable from the peak. Very close to School Jump's latch climb.
